rotisserieConfigurations.name: Heavy-Duty Commercial Double Rotisserie (Hardt Inferno 3500 / Rotisol GrandFlame, 64-Bird Capacity, 120,000 BTU/hr Radiant Ceramic)
rotisserieConfigurations.burnerType: Plasmalloy Micro-Porous Radiant Ceramic Infrared Burners (850°C–920°C)
rotisserieConfigurations.driveMechanism: Continuous Planetary Planetary Gear Drive with Dual Stainless Spit Rotors
rotisserieConfigurations.greaseCollectionSystem: Dual Slope V-Trough with Continuous Water Injection & Exterior Drain
rotisserieConfigurations.baselineFireRisk: LOW (With continuous water bath basin & daily drain)
rotisserieConfigurations.description: High-volume supermarket and institutional rotisserie featuring dual stacked roasting cavities; ceramic radiant tiles emit 2.5–3.5 µm infrared wavelengths directly into birds, while an active water injection reservoir prevents fat ignition in the collection sump.

rotisserieConfigurations.name: Standard Commercial Planetary Rotisserie (Hobart / BKI 32-Bird, 65,000 BTU/hr Vertical Rear Ceramic Radiant)
rotisserieConfigurations.burnerType: Rear-Wall Vertical Radiant Ceramic Infrared Tiles (800°C–870°C)
rotisserieConfigurations.driveMechanism: Single-Axis Planetary Spit Carousel with Independent Clutch
rotisserieConfigurations.greaseCollectionSystem: Removable Stainless Catch Basin with Central Ball-Valve Drain
rotisserieConfigurations.baselineFireRisk: MODERATE (Requires regular basin emptying during peak rushes)
rotisserieConfigurations.description: Industry-standard rotisserie found in supermarket delis; rear-mounted vertical ceramic burners face the revolving spit carousel. Fat dripping from upper spits can spatter sideways onto lower ceramic tile edges if airflow deflectors are misaligned.

rotisserieConfigurations.name: Countertop Convection Gas Rotisserie (16-Bird Unit, Atmospheric Blue-Flame Burners with Stainless Radiants)
rotisserieConfigurations.burnerType: Atmospheric Inconel Ribbon Burners with Perforated Stainless Radiants (700°C–760°C)
rotisserieConfigurations.baselineFireRisk: HIGH (Stainless radiant shields prone to grease pooling and flare-ups)
rotisserieConfigurations.description: Compact gas rotisserie utilizing perforated metal radiants over open atmospheric gas flames; lacks radiant ceramic thermal density, causing fat drippings to pool on metal shields and smolder at 350°C–450°C.

rotisserieConfigurations.name: Continuous Institutional Tunnel Rotisserie (Rotomatic 100-Bird Industrial Continuous Line, 160,000 BTU/hr Dual-Zone)
rotisserieConfigurations.burnerType: Multi-Zone Premix Modulating Infrared Ceramic Burners (880°C–950°C)
rotisserieConfigurations.driveMechanism: Overhead Heavy-Duty Conveyor Chain with Indexing Spit Hangers
rotisserieConfigurations.greaseCollectionSystem: Continuous Recirculating Oil-Water Separator Sump with External Chiller
rotisserieConfigurations.baselineFireRisk: LOW (Engineered deluge fire suppression & thermal cutoff)
rotisserieConfigurations.description: Industrial banquet roaster operating on a continuous conveyor loop; incorporates precision air curtain seals and cold-sump grease drainage to prevent rendered lipids from approaching flash temperatures.

rotisserieConfigurations.name: Aged Deli Rotisserie with Cracking Ceramic Tiles (10-Year-Old Unit, Clogged Gas Orifices, 50,000 BTU/hr)
rotisserieConfigurations.burnerType: Degraded Cordierite Ceramic with Gas Jet Blowby & Carbon Soot Crust (650°C–980°C Hotspots)
rotisserieConfigurations.driveMechanism: Slipping Gearbox with Uneven Carousel Rotation
rotisserieConfigurations.greaseCollectionSystem: Warped Single Basin with Clogged Drain Pipe
rotisserieConfigurations.baselineFireRisk: CRITICAL (Severe fire hazard: raw gas leakage and unburned grease puddling)
rotisserieConfigurations.description: Poorly maintained commercial rotisserie with fractured ceramic tiles; uneven fuel-air ratios produce heavy yellow lazy flames, incomplete hydrocarbon combustion, soot encrustation, and severe localized temperature spikes exceeding fat autoignition.

roastingBatchProfiles.name: Full-Capacity 64-Bird Commercial Roast (4.5 lb Broiler-Fryers, 180°C Roasting Cavity, 90-Min Dwell)
roastingBatchProfiles.description: Heavy commercial volume generating nearly 20 liters of boiling poultry lipids; intense fat dripping over rotating spits creates high aerosolization rates and continuous droplets striking radiant heat surfaces.

roastingBatchProfiles.name: Standard Supermarket Deli Batch (32-Bird Carousel, 3.8 lb Birds, 190°C Cavity, 75-Min Dwell)
roastingBatchProfiles.description: Standard deli production cycle; steady rendering of subcutaneous chicken fat with moderate spatter frequency against rear vertical burner guards.

roastingBatchProfiles.name: High-Fire Radiant Glaze & Crisping Finish (32 Birds, Max Infrared Boost 220°C Cavity, 15-Min Blast)
roastingBatchProfiles.description: Short-duration maximum thermal output used to blister and caramelize chicken skin; surface fat boils violently, driving micro-droplets directly into radiant ceramic burner pores.

roastingBatchProfiles.name: Clogged Drain Trough Scenario (64 Birds, Basin Drain Obstructed by Bone/Skin Debris)
roastingBatchProfiles.description: Critical failure state where rendered chicken fat cannot evacuate the cabinet; a pool of 15+ liters of 180°C liquid grease accumulates beneath the rotating spits, mere centimeters from radiant heat.

roastingBatchProfiles.name: Holding Mode / Thermal Decay Shift (68°C Cavity Temperature, Low Burner Fire)
roastingBatchProfiles.description: Extended warm-holding cycle; low exhaust velocity causes lingering vaporized grease to settle and condense heavily on cooler duct surfaces.

ventilationAndDuctworkDynamics.name: Dedicated NFPA 96 Type I Canopy Hood with UL 1046 Baffle Filters (2,400 CFM, Velocity 1,800 FPM)
ventilationAndDuctworkDynamics.description: Optimized commercial exhaust ventilation; high duct transport velocity maintains grease aerosol in suspension above condensation dew point until discharge into roof grease containment.

ventilationAndDuctworkDynamics.name: Shared Commercial Island Hood (1,500 CFM, Velocity 1,200 FPM, Mixed Appliance Capture)
ventilationAndDuctworkDynamics.description: Common commercial kitchen installation where rotisserie shares a hood plenum with fryers and ranges; lower duct velocity allows sub-micron vaporized lipids to deposit on interior duct elbows.

ventilationAndDuctworkDynamics.name: Undersized Blower with Long Horizontal Duct Run (>15m Run, 900 CFM, Velocity 750 FPM)
ventilationAndDuctworkDynamics.description: Severe fire violation; low air velocity and long duct transit allow grease vapors to cool far below their 140°C dew point, condensing thick, sticky, tar-like creosote along the horizontal duct invert.

ventilationAndDuctworkDynamics.name: Missing or Gapped Baffle Filters (Warpage Allowing 25% Air Bypass Straight into Ductwork)
ventilationAndDuctworkDynamics.description: Gaps between misaligned baffle filters allow heavy fat droplet spatter to bypass centrifugal extraction entirely, directly coating the exhaust fan impeller and duct riser.

ceramicBurnerAndShieldStates.name: Pristine Cordierite Ceramic Tiles with Stainless Flame Tamers (Uniform 880°C Glow, 0mm Soot)
ceramicBurnerAndShieldStates.description: Factory-calibrated ceramic infrared burners with 100% premix combustion; tile surface temperature exceeds the 390°C autoignition point of fat, vaporizing micro-droplets instantly without pooling or flare-up.

ceramicBurnerAndShieldStates.name: Moderate Carbon Glaze with Minor Hairline Ceramic Fissures (Localized Yellow Flame, 0.8mm Crust)
ceramicBurnerAndShieldStates.description: Partial clogging of ceramic pores with baked carbon residue; localized zones of incomplete combustion produce intermittent orange flame licks and elevated polycyclic aromatic hydrocarbon synthesis.

ceramicBurnerAndShieldStates.name: Fractured Ceramic Matrix with Raw Gas Blowby (Hotspot >980°C, Severe Yellow Flame Flares)
ceramicBurnerAndShieldStates.description: Cracked ceramic emitter leaking uncombusted gas; high localized thermal energy creates continuous ignition of grease spatters, generating tall flame plumes and heavy Benzo[a]pyrene emissions.

ceramicBurnerAndShieldStates.name: Grease-Soaked Perforated Stainless Deflector Shield (Heavy Char Crust, 3.5mm Baked Carbon)
ceramicBurnerAndShieldStates.description: Heavy accumulation of pyrolyzed animal lipid and carbonized skin on radiant metal shields; surface operates in the 480°C–550°C autoignition regime, causing continuous smoldering and persistent flame flare-ups.

sanitationAndFireSafetyProtocols.name: Gold Standard NFPA 96 Protocol: Daily Basin Scrub + Monthly Certified Chemical Hydro-Jet Duct Degrease
sanitationAndFireSafetyProtocols.fireSuppressionSystemState: Active Monitored Wet Chemical (Ansul R-102 / Pyro-Chem)
sanitationAndFireSafetyProtocols.description: Exemplary commercial fire safety; daily basin drainage and water reservoir flushing combined with monthly professional chemical pressure washing of all duct risers and exhaust fans.

sanitationAndFireSafetyProtocols.name: Standard Commercial Deli Regimen: Daily Interior Wipe + Quarterly Professional Duct Cleaning
sanitationAndFireSafetyProtocols.description: Complies with standard NFPA 96 Table 11.4 quarterly requirements for moderate-volume cooking; maintains acceptable duct safety provided high-fat batches do not exceed 2 cycles per day.

sanitationAndFireSafetyProtocols.name: Delinquent Maintenance: Infrequent Surface Wipe + Annual Duct Cleaning (Severe Non-Compliance)
sanitationAndFireSafetyProtocols.description: Dangerous fire hazard; uncleaned grease in horizontal duct runs forms a continuous fuel train capable of sustaining an uncontrollable Class K fire if ignited by a rotisserie burner flare-up.

sanitationAndFireSafetyProtocols.name: Uncertified Operation: DIY Interior Rags Only (Duct Never Cleaned, 6+ Years Accumulation)
sanitationAndFireSafetyProtocols.description: Imminent life safety hazard; internal ductwork and roof fan housing are coated in thick, semi-solid polymerized creosote with zero fire suppression protection.
